text.content:
Named Spirit · Ghost-Static, semi-mythical

Bound, by every account, into a dented conductor's lantern that keeps finding its way back into circulation no matter how many times it's supposedly been melted down, lost, or buried with whoever last carried it. The Brakeman will strike a deal with almost anyone — he's famous for never once refusing an honest ask — and every single person who's taken him up on it has arrived somewhere. Just never quite where, or in quite the condition, they were expecting.

Hollowbound trade Brakeman stories the way rail workers used to trade ghost-train stories: half warning, half brag. Everyone at the Last Exchange has heard of someone who bound him. Nobody currently there is holding the lantern.
